title: People Partner, Associate II
description:

Customer Service Excellence & Communication

Digital & Continuous Improvement Approach (AI-Enabled)

* Bachelor’s Degree in HR, IT, Business, or related field or equivalent work experience.

* Prior experience working in an HR contact center/shared service or operations environment supporting inquiries and transactions across multiple HR or P&C functions is preferred.

* Ability to apply knowledge guide materials in performing research and answering inquiries.
* Expertise working with digital tools, HR systems, and technology-enabled support platforms, including chat and AI-assisted tools.
* Interest in researching and applying new technologies including AI, automation, and chatbots to improve the support provided to the workforce and operational efficiency.
* Excellent judgment to validate information, identify when a blocking issue arises, and ensure AI-supported outputs meet policy, quality, and compliance standards.

title: Platform Architect -Integrated Learning
description:

MCAPS-Core accelerates customer outcomes and business growth. By uniting product, engineering, marketing, sales, customer success, and partners around a common customer mission, we help customers realize value faster and turn innovation into measurable business impact. Through deep technical expertise and differentiated go-to-market execution, we win competitively, capture market share, and scale repeatable growth motions. We differentiate through value creation - delivering world-class, AI-powered customer experiences that accelerate adoption, strengthen loyalty, and create sustainable competitive advantage, driving growth that outpaces the market.

The Customer & Commercial Success (CCS) organization, an organization within MCAPS-Core, is the connected engine that turns Microsoft’s commercial strategy into execution at scale — making it simpler and faster for the field to win for every customer, in every segment, region, and role. The organization brings together planning, landing, execution excellence, services portfolio and delivery, and field activation across ATU, STU, and CSU to accelerate customer value, drive growth, and strengthen the end-to-end experience across every customer moment.

This position is pivotal in shaping the next generation of learning through agentic experiences that make skilling more personalized, adaptive, and embedded in the flow of work.  
By combining agentic AI, machine learning, data, and automation, you will design and scale intelligent learning experiences that accelerate skill development, improve learner and customer outcomes, and strengthen organizational capability.  
The role goes beyond applying AI to existing learning processes. It will help reimagine how people discover, build, apply, and sustain skills, creating agentic experiences that understand context, orchestrate learning resources and actions, and continuously adapt to learner needs and business priorities.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

 **Responsibilities**

Strategic Program Management  

* Define and drive the AI, agentic systems, machine learning, data, and automation transformation strategy for L&D, aligning initiatives with business priorities and evolving customer needs.
* Lead programs from discovery and architecture through implementation, adoption, and ongoing optimization.
* Manage dependencies, risks, success measures, and cross-functional delivery.

Advanced Analytics & Machine Learning  

* Implement descriptive, diagnostic, predictive, and prescriptive analytics—including machine learning, and agentic AI to uncover skill gaps, forecast learning needs, and measure program impact.
* Build Microsoft Fabric data pipelines, lakehouses or warehouses, and Power BI reporting to support actionable insights and data-driven decisions.
* Establish data-quality controls and measurement frameworks to evaluate learning effectiveness and organizational capability.

Agentic AI & Personalized Learning  

* Design and deploy agentic AI solutions, including autonomous agents, adaptive learning systems, and intelligent tutoring experiences, with appropriate human oversight and operational safeguards.
* Integrate Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Search, Microsoft Copilot, and Azure Machine Learning to deliver personalized, scalable learning and knowledge experiences.
* Implement retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), grounding, evaluation, and feedback mechanisms to improve AI response quality and relevance.

Document & Speech Intelligence  

* Use Azure AI Document Intelligence to extract, classify, and validate information from structured and unstructured documents.
* Integrate Azure AI Speech capabilities, including speech-to-text and text-to-speech, into conversational, learning, and accessibility solutions.
* Develop workflows that convert documents and spoken interactions into searchable knowledge and actionable insights.

Cloud Architecture & Application Development  

* Architect secure, scalable Azure solutions using Azure App Service/Web Apps, Azure Functions, Azure Cosmos DB, and supporting cloud services.
* Develop applications, APIs, AI integrations, and data-processing components using Python and C#/.NET.
* Design data models, partitioning strategies, and secure access patterns for Azure Cosmos DB.
* Apply managed identities, role-based access control, secrets management, and monitoring across application environments.

CI/CD & Automation  

* Establish and maintain CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps, incorporating automated testing, security checks, and controlled deployments.
* Implement repeatable infrastructure and environment provisioning using infrastructure as code.
* Automate business and technical workflows using Power Automate, Azure Logic Apps, Azure Functions, and scripting.
* Improve delivery efficiency and operational reliability through reusable components and automated processes.

Continuous Improvement  

* Use real-time feedback, telemetry, and analytics to iterate on program and solution design.
* Monitor solution performance, reliability, adoption, and cost, ensuring sustained value in a fast-changing environment.

Stakeholder Engagement  

* Translate technical insights into clear recommendations for non-technical audiences.
* Collaborate with business leaders, subject-matter experts, engineering teams, and learning professionals.
* Foster a culture of data-driven decision-making and shared accountability for outcomes.

Responsible AI & Change Management  

* Champion fairness, transparency, privacy, security, and accessibility in AI-enabled learning and knowledge systems.
* Establish appropriate evaluation, human oversight, and governance for agentic AI solutions.

 **Qualifications**

Master's Degree or equivalent 10+ year(s) experience in learning and development, relevant technical roles, business development, quota management, human resources (HR), customer success, collection management, research/restoration evaluation, industry, program/project management, or corporate education OR Bachelor's degree or equivalent AND 12+ years experience in learning and development, relevant technical roles, business development, field or sales, HR, customer success, collection management, research/restoration evaluation, industry, or program/project management, corporate education OR equivalent experience.

Additional Required Qualifications:  

* Demonstrated experience in technical program/project management, learning and development, knowledge management, customer success, or a related technical role.
* Experience leading cross-functional initiatives and translating business requirements into technical solutions and measurable outcomes.

Technical expertise  

* Microsoft Azure: Hands-on experience designing and delivering secure, scalable cloud solutions, including identity, access management, monitoring, and application integration.
* Azure AI: Experience building AI-powered applications using Azure AI services, including Azure OpenAI and Azure AI Foundry, with an understanding of agentic workflows, RAG, evaluation, and responsible AI.
* Azure AI Document Intelligence: Experience implementing document extraction, classification, and validation workflows.
* Azure AI Speech: Experience integrating speech-to-text and text-to-speech into applications or automated workflows.
* Azure App Service/Web Apps: Experience developing, deploying, securing, and monitoring web applications and APIs.
* Azure Cosmos DB: Experience with NoSQL data modeling, partitioning, querying, and secure application persistence.
* Microsoft Fabric: Experience with data integration, engineering, and analytics using pipelines, lakehouses, and Power BI.
* Python and C#/.NET: Proficiency in developing APIs, AI integrations, data-processing components, and automation.
* CI/CD: Experience implementing build, test, and deployment pipelines using Azure DevOps.
* Automation: Experience automating workflows using Power Automate, Azure Logic Apps, Azure Functions, and scripting.
* Working knowledge of source control, automated testing, API integration, cloud security, and operational troubleshooting.

Leadership and communication  

* Strong analytical, problem-solving, stakeholder-management, and communication skills.
* Ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical audiences and influence decisions across organizational boundaries.
* Ability to balance strategic program leadership with hands-on technical execution.

Additional Preferred Qualifications:  

* Bachelor or Master’s degree or equivalent advanced experience in a relevant discipline.
* Significant experience delivering enterprise-scale AI, learning, knowledge-management, or digital-transformation programs.
* Experience with Azure Machine Learning, model deployment, and MLOps practices.
* Experience implementing AI evaluation, prompt/version management, monitoring, and governance practices.
* Experience provisioning cloud infrastructure using Bicep, Terraform, or Azure Resource Manager templates.

* Familiarity with enterprise data governance, privacy, accessibility, and security requirements.
* Relevant Microsoft certifications in Azure, AI, data, Fabric, or DevOps.

Education

### **Who You Are**

title: Senior Computer Scientist - C++
description:
The Opportunity
  
Adobe builds products that power millions of customer experiences worldwide. Behind these products are sophisticated software systems operating at scale, where performance, reliability, security, and engineering excellence are fundamental requirements.
  
We are looking for a Senior Computer Scientist with deep C\+\+ expertise who enjoys solving complex technical problems and taking ownership of significant areas of the product. You will shape architecture, build high\-performance software, make critical technical decisions, and influence solutions that span components and teams.
  
We value engineers who are self\-driven, proactive, and outcome\-oriented — engineers who challenge assumptions, solve problems at their root, make pragmatic tradeoffs, and take responsibility for making the systems they own better, more reliable, and easier to evolve.
  
  

What You'll Do
  
Own and evolve significant technical areas end\-to\-end — from understanding ambiguous problems and defining the right solution through architecture, implementation, production validation, and long\-term evolution.
  
Design and build high\-performance C\+\+ systems , making thoughtful decisions around architecture, concurrency, memory management, resource utilization, and scalability.
  
Drive technical direction for complex problems — evaluate alternatives, make pragmatic tradeoffs, and influence architecture decisions across components and teams.
  
Solve problems at the root — identify systemic causes rather than treating symptoms, and drive durable solutions that reduce recurring issues and technical debt.
  
Own outcomes, not just tasks — proactively identify gaps, risks, and opportunities and drive them to closure with minimal direction.
  
Solve complex problems across boundaries , collaborating with engineers, architects, product managers, and other teams to deliver cohesive solutions.
  
Raise the engineering bar through architecture and code reviews, performance optimization, testing, and engineering best practices.
  
Build for operational excellence with strong focus on performance, reliability, security, observability, maintainability, and efficient resource utilization.

Leverage AI\-assisted engineering to accelerate development and problem solving, improve engineering workflows, and increase team productivity.

B.Tech/M.Tech in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  
10\+ years of hands\-on software engineering experience , with a strong track record of owning and delivering complex technical solutions.
  
Deep expertise in C\+\+ , including modern C\+\+, memory management, concurrency, multithreading, STL, and performance optimization.

Strong proficiency in AI\-assisted engineering , leveraging tools such as Claude, Codex, or Copilot to accelerate development, improve problem solving, and enhance engineering productivity.
  
Strong technical judgment and problem\-solving ability , with the ability to navigate ambiguity and influence technical decisions across teams.
  
  

What Success Looks Like
  
Success in this role is not measured only by the features you deliver. You will be successful when you:
  
Own and evolve significant technical areas with minimal direction and strong technical judgment.
  
Turn ambiguous, complex problems into clear technical direction and executable solutions .
  
Make architecture decisions that balance performance, scalability, reliability, maintainability, and long\-term evolution .
  
Solve systemic problems at their root and eliminate recurring sources of complexity, performance issues, and operational risk.

title: Executive Assistant to CEO
description:
### **Executive Assistant to CEO**

  

Reporting directly to the CEO, the Executive Assistant provides executive support in a one\-on\-one working relationship. The Executive Assistant serves as the primary point of contact for internal and external constituencies on all matters involving the CEO. The Executive Assistant also serves as a liaison to the Core Committee and senior management teams; organizes and coordinates executive outreach and external relations efforts; and oversees special projects. The ideal individual will have the ability to exercise good judgment in a variety of situations, with strong written and verbal communication, administrative, and organizational skills, and the ability to maintain a realistic balance among multiple priorities. The Executive Assistant will have the ability to work independently on projects, from conception to completion, and must be able to work under pressure and travel at times to handle a wide variety of activities and confidential matters with discretion.

 **Specific responsibilities:**

  

* Completes a broad variety of administrative tasks for the CEO, including managing an extremely active calendar of appointments; completing expense reports; composing and preparing correspondence that is sometimes confidential; arranging complex and detailed travel plans, itineraries, and agendas; and compiling documents for travel\-related meetings. Plans, coordinates, and ensures the CEO's schedule is followed and respected. Provides "gatekeeper" and "gateway" roles, creating win\-win situations for direct access to the CEO's time and office

  

* Communicates directly, on behalf of the CEO, with the Core Committee, Administration, HR, Operations, Branches, Zonal managers, Processing, Accounts, legal, etc.

  

* Research prioritizes, and follows up on incoming issues and concerns addressed to the CEO, including those of a sensitive or confidential nature. Determines the appropriate course of action, referral, or response.

  

* Provides a bridge for smooth communication between the CEO and internal departments; demonstrating leadership to maintain credibility, trust, \& support with senior management staff.

  

* Works closely and effectively with the CEO to keep him well informed of upcoming commitments and responsibilities, following up appropriately. Acts as a "barometer," having a sense of the issues taking place in the environment and keeping the CEO updated.

  

* Provides leadership to build relationships crucial to the success of the organization, and manages a variety of projects for the CEO, some of which may have organizational impact.

  

* Completes critical aspects of deliverables with a hands\-on approach, including drafting acknowledgement letters, personal correspondence, and other tasks that facilitate the CEO's ability to effectively lead the company.

  

* Prioritizes conflicting needs; handles matters expeditiously, and proactively, and follows through on projects to successful completion, often with deadline pressures.

 **NB:** The principal responsibilities listed above are an illustrative list and not an exhaustive list. Additional responsibilities will be added from time to time, depending on organizational requirements.

 **KEY SELECTION CRITERIA**

**Qualification**

  

* Any UG degree with relevant experience
* MBA Corporate Governance / Secretarial Course preferred

**Experience**


Minimum of 3 to 5 years’ experience in administration.

**Age**


25–30 years

**Sex**


Female/Male (Preference for Female candidates)

**Computer skills**

* Excellent MS Office, internet and emails

**Language skills**

* Good written and oral communication skills in English.
* Good email\-drafting skills in English
* **Functional skills**
* Good verbal and written communication \& presentation skills with strong business\-related knowledge
* Strong organizational skills that reflect the ability to perform and prioritize multiple tasks seamlessly with excellent attention to detail
* Very strong interpersonal skills and the ability to build relationships with stakeholders, including staff, Core committee, and external partners § Expert level written and verbal communication skills
* Demonstrated proactive approaches to problem\-solving with strong decision\-making capability
* Emotional maturity
* Proven ability to handle confidential information with discretion, be adaptable to various competing demands, and demonstrate the highest level of customer/client service and response
* Demonstrated ability to achieve high\-performance goals and meet deadlines in a fast\-paced environment
* Forward\-looking thinker, who actively seeks opportunities and proposes solutions

**Pay Scale**


Rs 3\.6 lakh to 5\.4 lakh per annum

 **Probation**


3 months

 **Training**


1 week (paid training)

Yearly increment \| Performance Bonus \| Paid Leaves \| Company Laptop and Mobile phone with SIM card

No Work\-from\-Home benefit
